text: dsh-profile-multica 通过独立 profile 和版本化 JSONL 协议，将 DSH Agent 与 Session 服务接入 Multica。它提供运行探测、模型目录查询和单任务执行，可指定模型与推理等级、创建或恢复会话，并挂载 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务。执行时会流式转发文本、思考和工具事件，支持取消并刷新会话持久化。适合希望从 Multica 调用 DeepSeek Harness 的用户；需要兼容版本的 DSH、Node.js 与 pnpm，也可配置会话目录、工具模式和权限预设。

dsh-profile-multica connects DSH Agent and Session services to Multica over JSONL. It provides model discovery and one-task execution, with model selection, session resume, task-scoped MCP servers, streamed events, and cancellation. A compatible DSH release, Node.js, and pnpm are required.
想让 Multica 通过 JSONL 调用 DSH 的 Agent。
有没有办法从 Multica 查询 DSH 当前可用的模型？
让我的任务能在启动 DSH 时指定模型和推理等级。
我想继续之前保存的 DSH 会话，能从外部请求恢复吗？
DSH 怎么把执行中的文本和工具事件实时传给另一个程序？
希望任务执行到一半时可以发请求取消它。
怎样让 DSH 会话使用我为单个任务配置的 MCP server？
I need a JSONL bridge that lets Multica run a DSH agent task.
dsh-profile-multica 的功能「模型目录发现」：调用 `--list-models` 输出已安装提供方和模型，并附带推理等级信息；单个提供方查询失败时写诊断并继续处理其他提供方。
dsh-profile-multica 的功能「JSONL 任务执行」：Multica 通过 `--stdio` 发送 execute 请求，桥接器创建或恢复 DSH 会话，提交提示并将运行结果作为 JSONL 事件流输出。
dsh-profile-multica 的功能「任务取消」：活动任务期间接收带匹配 request_id 的 cancel JSONL 请求，终止信号会传递给 Agent；没有活动任务或编号不符时返回协议错误。
dsh-profile-multica 的功能「任务级 MCP 接入」：execute 请求可附带 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP MCP server 配置，桥接器在 Agent 初始化时挂载服务并应用调用超时。
dsh-profile-multica 使用没有交互审批往返的 JSONL 协议，权限由 DSH_PERMISSION_MODE 的非交互预设决定；超出所选策略的操作无法等待审批。

dsh-profile-multica README · dsh-profile-multica：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

An installable community bundle that exposes the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) CLI to Multica through a versioned JSONL process protocol.

See the [protocol reference](docs/protocol.md) for request, event, cancellation, and exit semantics.

The bundle adds three commands to a dedicated profile:

```bash
dsh --profile multica --probe
dsh --profile multica --list-models
dsh --profile multica --stdio
```

dsh-profile-multica README · dsh-profile-multica：`--probe` prints the discovery frame used by Multica. `--list-models` projects the installed DSH providers, models, and reasoning levels. `--stdio` accepts one version-1 execute request, streams Agent and Session events as JSONL, accepts cancellation for the active request, flushes persistence, prints one terminal result, and exits. Protocol frames use stdout; diagnostics use stderr.

dsh-profile-multica README · dsh-profile-multica：An execute request can create a fresh Agent or resume a persisted Session, select a provider/model/reasoning level, and mount task-scoped stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP servers. `MULTICA_DSH_SESSION_ROOT` selects the JSONL persistence directory. `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE` may be `read-only`, `workspace-write`, or `danger-full-access`; the default is `workspace-write`. This transport has no interactive approval round trip, so operations outside the selected policy fail instead of waiting.

dsh-profile-multica README · Requirements：- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.7` or a compatible later prerelease
- pnpm on `PATH` for `dsh plugin`

dsh-profile-multica README · Install：After the package is published to npm:

```bash
npm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7
dsh plugin --profile multica add dsh-profile-multica
dsh --profile multica --probe
```

To install a local checkout, build a tarball first:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile multica add /absolute/path/dsh-profile-multica-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile multica --probe

dsh-profile-multica README · Install：The plugin command creates the `multica` profile over the official `dsh-base`, installs this bundle, and appends its declared patch layer. Profile installation and the Multica daemon must run as the same OS user and use the same `DSH_HOME` when it is customized.

dsh-profile-multica README · Develop：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build

`smoke:pack` packs the current checkout, installs the tarball into an isolated profile using the supported official DSH release, verifies `--probe`, and removes the temporary profile.

Before publishing, add the `dsh-plugin` GitHub topic and verify the packed tarball against a clean official CLI installation.
dsh-profile-multica README · Model experience：The bridge adds no system-prompt text or tool schema. It submits Multica input as an ordinary user message and projects existing DSH events.

dsh-profile-multica README · Limitations：- One process accepts one execute request; Multica launches a fresh process per task.
- The protocol has no approval response. Choose an appropriate non-interactive permission mode for the target environment.
- Model discovery reports a failing provider on stderr and continues with the remaining providers.
- The package tracks prerelease DSH APIs, so a new DSH prerelease may require a matching plugin release.
